#Function for evaluation
def compute_metrics(y, pred):
    from sklearn.metrics import classification_report
    from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix
    from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
    print("Accuracy: \n",accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("Confusion matrix: \n", confusion_matrix(y, pred))
    print("\n Classification report: \n", classification_report(y, pred))

#Model building and testing version 0.1
def build_test_model(model, X, y, tsz):
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=tsz)
    clf = model()
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    #test on train set
    pred = clf.predict(X_train)
    compute_metrics(y_train, pred)

#Model building and testing version 0.2
#Add performance on test set
def build_test_model(model, X, y, tsz):
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=tsz)
    clf = model()
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    #test on train set
    pred = clf.predict(X_train)
    print("\n   Performance on Training set \n")
    compute_metrics(y_train, pred)

     #test on test set
    pred = clf.predict(X_test)
    print("\n   Performance on Test set \n")
    compute_metrics(y_test, pred)
